pairs: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me,
And the word of the Lord came to me,
the prince of the head of Meshech and Tubal,
And you shall say to him:
prince of the head of Meshech and Tubal.
And I will turn you around,
et ponam frenum in maxillis tuis:
and I will place a bit in your jaws.
And I will lead you away,
equos et equites vestitos loricis universos,
the horses and the horsemen all clothed in armor,
hastam et clypeum arripientium et gladium.
equipped with spears and light shields and swords,
all with heavy shields and helmets,
and the many peoples with you.
et omnem multitudinem tuam quæ coacervata est ad te:
with all your multitude which has been assembled to you.
And you shall be like a commandment to them.
After many days, you will be visited.
in novissimo annorum venies ad terram quæ reversa est a gladio,
At the end of the years, you will arrive at the land which was turned back by the sword,
et congregata est de populis multis ad montes Israël, qui fuerunt deserti jugiter:
and which has been gathered from many peoples to the mountains of Israel that have been continually abandoned.
These ones have been led away from the peoples,
et habitabunt in ea confidenter universi.
and all of them will be living confidently within it.
Ascendens autem quasi tempestas venies, et quasi nubes,
But you will ascend and arrive like a tempest and like a cloud,
so that you may cover the land,
and the many peoples with you.
words will climb into your heart,
and you will invent a most wicked plan.
‘I will ascend to the land without a wall.
I will go to those who are resting and dwelling securely.
All these live without a wall;
vectes et portæ non sunt eis:
they have no bars or gates.’
et invadas prædam; ut inferas manum tuam super eos qui deserti fuerant,
and you will take possession of prey, so that you may lay your hand upon those who had been abandoned,
et super populum qui est congregatus ex gentibus,
and upon a people who were gathered away from the Gentiles,
qui possidere cœpit et esse habitator umbilici terræ.
a people who have begun to possess, and to be the inhabitants of, the navel of the earth.
and all its lions will say to you:
‘Could you have arrived in order to purchase from the spoils?
Numquid ad sumenda spolia tu venis?
ecce ad diripiendam prædam congregasti multitudinem tuam,
you have gathered your multitude in order to plunder a prey,
so that you may take silver and gold,
and carry away equipment and substance,
Because of this, son of man,
fili hominis, et dices ad Gog:
prophesy, and you shall say to Gog:
How is it that you do not know of that day, when my people,
cum habitaverit populus meus Israël confidenter, scies?
Israel, will be living in confidence?
Et venies de loco tuo a lateribus aquilonis,
And you will advance from your place,
from the parts of the north,
you and the many peoples with you,
all of them riding on horses,
a great assembly and an immense army.
Et ascendes super populum meum Israël quasi nubes,
And you will rise up over my people, Israel, like a cloud,
so that you may cover the earth.
In the latter days, you will be.
et adducam te super terram meam:
And I will lead you over my own land,
ut sciant gentes me cum sanctificatus fuero in te in oculis eorum,
so that the Gentiles may know me, when I will have been sanctified in you, O Gog,
Thus says the Lord God: Therefore,
de quo locutus sum in diebus antiquis in manu servorum meorum prophetarum Israël,
about whom I spoke in the days of antiquity, by the hand of my servants the prophets of Israel,
qui prophetaverunt in diebus illorum temporum, ut adducerem te super eos.
who prophesied in the days of those times that I would lead you over them.
And this shall be in that day,
in die adventus Gog super terram Israël,
in the day of the advent of Gog over the land of Israel,
ascendet indignatio mea in furore meo.
my indignation will rise up in my fury.
in igne iræ meæ locutus sum,
in my zeal and in the fire of my wrath,
quia in die illa erit commotio magna super terram Israël:
that there shall be a great commotion over the land of Israel, in that day.
et commovebuntur a facie mea pisces maris,
And before my face there shall be stirred up: the fish of the sea,
and the flying things of the air,
et bestiæ agri, et omne reptile quod movetur super humum,
and the beasts of the field, and every crawling thing that moves across the soil,
cunctique homines qui sunt super faciem terræ:
and all the men who are upon the face of the earth.
And the mountains will be overturned,
et omnis murus corruet in terram.
and every wall will fall in ruin to the ground.
Et convocabo adversus eum in cunctis montibus meis gladium,
And I will call for the sword against him on all my mountains,
gladius uniuscujusque in fratrem suum dirigetur.
Each one’s sword will be directed toward his brother.
And I will judge him by pestilence,
ignem et sulphur pluam super eum,
I will rain fire and brimstone upon him,
et super populos multos qui sunt cum eo.
and upon the many peoples who are with him.
et notus ero in oculis multarum gentium:
And I will be known in the eyes of the many nations.
And they shall know that I am the Lord.”
